Alpha (Japanese: アルファ Alpha) is one of the two main characters and younger brother of in the Pokémon Omega Ruby Crimson Passion and Pokémon Alpha Sapphire Indigo Wisdom manga.

==Pokémon==
 

==Trivia==
Although Alpha is the first letter of the Greek alphabet, Alpha is the younger of the two brothers.
